benefits.name: 5% Korean Air Ticket Discount
benefits.description: One 5% discount coupon on Korean Air tickets each year, usable for the cardmember and one companion.
benefits.terms: Primary cardmember receives one 5% discount coupon in their SKYPASS account at account opening and each anniversary year. Valid one year from deposit. Usable for a reservation of up to two travelers (primary cardmember and one companion). Applies to base fares on koreanair.com only; excludes taxes and fees.

benefits.name: Korean Air Lounge Vouchers
benefits.description: Two complimentary Korean Air Lounge vouchers each year.
benefits.terms: Issued to the primary cardmember after account opening and each anniversary date after the annual fee is paid. Valid for 1 year from issue, one-time use each. Access limited to Korean Air owned lounges in Los Angeles, New York, and Honolulu, and the Korean Air Prestige Lounge in Incheon, Korea.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Insurance coverage for car rentals made with the card.
benefits.terms: Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply; see the Visa Guide to Benefits for coverage details.

earningRates.terms: Eligible Korean Air ticket purchases where Korean Air is the merchant of record, such as tickets purchased through Korean Air ticket agents or koreanair.com.
Eligible net purchases at hotels, restaurants, fast-food restaurants, or bars (including takeout and restaurant delivery).
